title: 入口专题 C5：记录焦点状态机重写，标签进输入框行首，去掉钉住与「改为问」，从会话 metadata 读回
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ④ topic child. Source: topic #37853 (Jack: 「"页面里加按钮"的需求 作废」 06:28Z; card 「撤掉 ask_ai」 06:30Z; 「问 AI」 06:33Z; 「同意，立专题卡，非 cloud 的任务，让 objectstack #3 座位接手」 07:12Z, all 2026-11-27). Business reason: carried by the parent.
Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#37853 (rulings, target experience, card table, topic acceptance). Evidence: an independent Fable review of objectstack and cloud `main` (2026-11-27) checked every file:line below.
Owner: **repo:objectstack#3** (Jack 07:12Z 「非 cloud 的任务，让 objectstack #3 座位接手」). Reserved under topic #37853 (`pm:epic`), not `pm:queue`: other seats leave it.

Grading: area:ux · Task · p1 · size M–L · target: before 19.0 GA (the pin control and 「改为问」 have only shipped in prereleases).
Blocked-by: C0a (#37854); C1 (#37856) (removes `setChatFocus` and the `ask_ai` focus handler); #37799 and #37803 (splits of `ChatbotEnhanced` / `AiChatPage`, >3000 lines each, wait for the maintainer's merge). Ships in the same release as C4 (#37860).
Dedupe: searched `chatFocus`, `record chip`: #36999 and #37276 (closed) built today's version.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：重写记录焦点：未发送的新会话默认带当前页面记录，标签放进输入框行首，× 去掉后退回「正在看：X」；去掉钉住按钮和「改为问《X》？」；从会话里读回焦点，换标签页或从历史重开不丢。
- 要你做什么：先合 #37799、#37803。

## Background (verified)
- Today: unpinned shows a page chip (also on lists and dashboards) with a pin button when the page has one record; pinned shows 「正在问：X」 with remove; switching records asks 「改为问《X》？」. State is only `focus`, `declined`, kept in **sessionStorage only**, so a new tab or reopening from history loses it (`console/ai/ChatFocusRow.tsx:91-168`; `layout/chatFocus.ts:10-16,37-41,234-253`).
- The composer area of `ChatbotEnhanced` has only `promptHeaderSlot` (`AiChatPage.tsx:2023`); the chip needs an in-composer slot.

## What to do
1. State `{ focus, dismissed }`; drop `declined`, `follow` and the host registry.
   - Unsent conversation: effective focus = current page record (`surfaceRecord()`) unless dismissed.
   - First send fixes focus and carries `dismissed`.
   - After that, focus persists across navigation (ADR-0160 D6).
2. Display:
   - With focus: a chip inside the composer at the line start: object icon + record name + ×. × visible on `focus-within` and always on touch, hit area ≥24px; unknown name → `object · id`; RTL (ar) puts it on the right automatically.
   - Without focus: today's page chip 「正在看：X」 (no ×), lists and dashboards included.
   - Agents without `capabilities.focus`: UI and request exactly as today.
3. Remove the pin button, the 「改为问《X》？」 prompt, keys `console.ai.focus.pin/switchPrompt/switchAccept/switchDecline` (update the `de-quote-pairing-3876` test), and the pin-only exports left after C1 (#37856) (`gen:api-surface`).
4. Read back: when a conversation loads, restore focus from its `metadata` (written by cloud C6 (objectstack-ai/cloud#5113)). The request body stays authoritative.
5. Rewrite `chatFocus-36999.test.tsx`.

## Acceptance
- Unsent new conversation follows record changes; after the first send it does not.
- × → page chip, never re-added in that conversation, kept after the first send.
- Reopening from history in a new tab restores the chip; follow-ups send `context.focus`.
- Lists / dashboards keep the page chip; agents without `capabilities.focus` unchanged.
- × keyboard-reachable, visible on touch, ≥24px; chip at line start in Arabic.
